title: Add ability to search for wallpapers
line: The wallpaper picker now has a search field that filters wallpapers by name or file name.
explanation: The Image wallpaper picker listed every installed and added wallpaper with no way to filter them, so finding one in a large collection meant scrolling. The picker's existing KSortFilterProxyModel can filter, but the grid's current-index binding (Math.min(indexOf(cfg_Image), count - 1)) re-evaluates in the middle of the proxy's row removals, which left the GridView showing the wrong wallpapers after a filter change. The change adds a Kirigami.SearchField as a header action (Ctrl+F comes from SearchField itself) and a short filterRowCallback matching the display name or the file/folder name case-insensitively; on each query change it drops the index binding, re-filters, scrolls to the top and rebinds it. The dynamic-mode combo now reads the current wallpaper from the model instead of the grid's current item, which is missing while the search hides it.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: Add a search field to the wallpaper picker

Finding an image in a large wallpaper collection meant scrolling through
the whole grid. Add a search field to the Images header that filters the
wallpapers by name or file name, ignoring case; Ctrl+F focuses it.

BUG: 520221

media.caption: Master: the Images header has only Add and Get New, no way to search
With the fix: typing "al" in the new search field leaves Altai, Fallen Leaf, Opal and Waterfall

review.text: MR !7407 works and the screenshots show filtering, but it is far heavier than the feature needs: about 1000 lines, including a new C++ ICU StringSearch class for matching names, a recursive walk of the header's children to find the overflow button, separate inline and popup field tracking, and a rewrite of the grid's current-index handling. KSortFilterProxyModel already offers filterString/filterRoleName with case-insensitive matching, and the index logic changes touch Apply/Cancel behaviour that is unrelated to search. Since this is Peder's MR, the useful step is review feedback on !7407 asking to slim it down, not a separate fix.
changes: Drop WallpaperSearch/ICU and filter with KSortFilterProxyModel's filterString (case-insensitive, on display name plus a filename role) or a short filterRowCallback using localeCompare/toLowerCase
Replace findSearchButton's child-tree walk and the inline/popup field bookkeeping with a plain Kirigami.SearchField in the header (or Kirigami's own action handling for Ctrl+F)
Keep the currentIndex/resetCurrentIndex rewrite to the minimum the filter needs, or split it into its own commit with its reason
